title: Politics and public services — in sentences
summary: Use the English meaning as well as the Swedish context to choose or type the missing word or phrase. Practise civic vocabulary without memorising a changing list of parties. Både … och adds two things; varken … eller excludes both. Även om and trots att introduce subordinate clauses.

s01.sentenceGloss: She speaks both Swedish and English.

s02.sentenceGloss: He drinks neither coffee nor tea.

s03.sentenceGloss: I will cycle even if it rains tomorrow.
s03.note: Även om introduces a hypothetical concession.

s04.sentenceGloss: She arrived on time although the bus was late.
s04.note: Trots att introduces a factual concession.

s05.note: Ett val is an election here.

s06.sentenceGloss: She is a member of a political party.

s07.sentenceGloss: The children go to school and learn to read.

s08.sentenceGloss: Although it is raining, he arrives on time.
s08.note: After the initial subordinate clause comes the finite verb kommer.
